description.fun: Victini is said to bring victory: one Pokédex claims Trainers with a Victini always win, whatever the contest. It makes an endless supply of energy inside its little body and shares it with anyone it touches. Its look seems to borrow from usagi-ringo, apples cut into rabbit shapes, and its V-shaped ears suit a Pokémon from Generation V. It's the only Pokémon numbered 000 in a Pokédex.
description.guide: Victini is a Psychic- and Fire-type Mythical Pokémon said to bring victory to the Trainer it befriends. It creates unlimited energy inside its body and can share it with others by touch. It is No. 000 in the Unova Pokédex and was designed by Mana Ibe.
description.tagline: A tiny bringer of victory with V-shaped ears.
